title: Core: document export to image (snapshotFrame)
description: The snapshotFrame function in packages/core/src/engine/snapshot.ts should work end-to-end: render a frame to an OffscreenCanvas using the renderer, return as a Blob. Check if it's fully wired up by reading the file. If it uses the Canvas renderer, make sure it calls the same renderFrame/getTweenedFrame pipeline that the authoring UI uses. If OffscreenCanvas is unavailable (Node.js), return null. Add unit tests using a mock canvas if needed.
